title: Return the same translated validation messages in forms and endpoints
goal: Share resource conventions and custom ValidationAttribute.FormatMessage formatting across generated Blazor and Minimal API validation; RC2 replaces the earlier formatter interface.

selectionNotes: Requires .NET 11 shared async DataAnnotations and generated Extensions.Validation metadata; no net10.0 package route is claimed.
Blazor live field validation requires an interactive mode; static SSR validates during posts. WebAssembly needs browser-usable services/resources and independent server validation.
Localization requires IStringLocalizerFactory and correct declaring-type resource names. RC2 uses ValidationAttribute.FormatMessage, not the removed formatter interface.

packageAssets: Microsoft.Extensions.Validation runtime/reference assemblies and ValidationsGenerator from Microsoft.AspNetCore.App.Ref; SDK-aligned Microsoft.AspNetCore.App.Internal.Assets browser files. No redundant PackageReference in the measured SDK.
platforms: ASP.NET Core server; actual Windows x64 HTTP and Chromium 154 Interactive Server execution. WebAssembly/Auto behavior is source-reviewed, not executed here.
renderingModes: Static SSR: server POST validation only
Interactive Server: live field and awaited submit validation
Interactive WebAssembly/Auto: supply browser-usable rule endpoints, localization and prerender services
prerequisites: Use Microsoft.NET.Sdk.Web with net11.0, C# 15.0, nullable and implicit usings enabled. The measured SDK supplies Microsoft.Extensions.Validation assemblies and ValidationsGenerator from Microsoft.AspNetCore.App.Ref, plus aligned Microsoft.AspNetCore.App.Internal.Assets browser files. A redundant PackageReference produced NU1510; none is needed here. Keep matching generator/runtime/browser assets when using another toolset.
The declaring model namespace/root namespace is Playbook.Samples; resource lookup requires matching embedded resource names. AddLocalization does not choose request/circuit culture.
constraints: Requires .NET 11 shared async DataAnnotations and generated Extensions.Validation metadata; no net10.0 package route is claimed.
Blazor live field validation requires an interactive mode; static SSR validates during posts. WebAssembly needs browser-usable services/resources and independent server validation.
Localization requires IStringLocalizerFactory and correct declaring-type resource names. RC2 uses ValidationAttribute.FormatMessage, not the removed formatter interface.
No MVC/Razor Pages adapter, atomic reservation, arbitrary cross-assembly coverage, trimming/AOT proof or conditional older-target route is claimed.
stabilityLimitations: Stable contracts compiled/executed with .NET 11 RC2; GA reconciliation pending. No experimental opt-in.
